collection.title: Mercedes-Benz CL Class 2006 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz A Class 2006 to 2014 (W216) model which requires a 28" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
